title.ru: Глагол to be: am / is / are

theory.uz:
to be fe’li hozirgi zamonda uch shaklda keladi:
• I am (I'm) • he / she / it is (he's, she's, it's) • we / you / they are (we're, you're, they're)
Inkor: not qo‘shiladi — I'm not, she isn't (is not), they aren't (are not).
Savolda fe’l oldinga chiqadi: Is he a pupil? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
Misol: My sister is ten. We are in the classroom.

title.uz: Egalik: my, your, his, her… va 's

theory.uz:
Egalik olmoshlari otdan oldin keladi:
I → my, you → your, he → his, she → her, it → its, we → our, they → their.
Misol: She has got a cat. Her cat is white. — Uning mushugi oq.
's — kimningdir narsasi: Ali's bag — Alining sumkasi, my mum's car — onamning mashinasi.
Whose …? — Kimning …? Whose pen is this? — It's Zarina's.

Ko‘plikda odatda -s qo‘shiladi: a book → books, a cat → cats.
-s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x dan keyin -es: a bus → buses, a box → boxes, a watch → watches.
Undosh + y → -ies: a city → cities, a baby → babies (lekin a boy → boys).  -f / -fe → -ves: leaf → leaves.
Maxsus shakllar: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice.
this → these, that → those: These are my shoes. Those birds are big.

What? — Nima?  Who? — Kim?  Where? — Qayerda?  When? — Qachon?
Why? — Nega? (javob: Because …)  How? — Qanday?  How old? — Necha yoshda?
How many? — Nechta?  Whose? — Kimning?  Which? — Qaysi? (tanlash kerak bo‘lsa)
Misol: Where do you live? — I live in Bukhara. When is your birthday? — It's in May.

title.uz: Present Simple: I play / she plays

theory.uz:
Present Simple — odatiy, doimiy ishlar: I go to school every day.
he / she / it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: she plays, he reads.
-o, -sh, -ch, -x, -s dan keyin -es: goes, watches; undosh + y → -ies: study → studies; have → has.
Inkor: don't / doesn't + fe’l: I don't like milk. He doesn't like fish.
Savol: Do / Does + ega + fe’l: Do you speak English? Does she live here? — Yes, she does.

title.en: Daily routine, time, adverbs of frequency

theory.uz:
Vaqt: What time is it? — It's seven o’clock (7:00). It's half past eight (8:30).
quarter past nine — 9:15;  quarter to ten — 9:45.
Kun tartibi: get up, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed.
always (doim) → usually (odatda) → often (tez-tez) → sometimes (ba’zan) → never (hech qachon).
Bu so‘zlar asosiy fe’ldan oldin, to be dan keyin keladi: I always get up at 7. She is never late.

Present Continuous — hozir, ayni paytda bo‘layotgan ish: I am reading now.
Tuzilishi: am / is / are + fe’l-ing: She is dancing. They are playing.
-ing qo‘shish: write → writing (e tushadi), swim → swimming, run → running, sit → sitting.
Inkor: He isn't sleeping. Savol: Are you listening? — Yes, I am.
Kalit so‘zlar: now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!

Harakat fe’llari: run — yugurmoq, walk — yurmoq, swim — suzmoq, dance — raqsga tushmoq,
climb — tirmashib chiqmoq, ride — minmoq (velosiped, ot), write — yozmoq, sleep — uxlamoq.
Hozir bo‘layotgan harakat: He is running. They are dancing.
Odatiy harakat: I swim every Sunday.  Savol: What is he doing? — He is climbing.

Kasblar: doctor — shifokor, teacher — o‘qituvchi, cook — oshpaz, farmer — fermer, pilot — uchuvchi,
builder — quruvchi, firefighter — o‘t o‘chiruvchi, police officer — politsiyachi.
Joylar: hospital — kasalxona, shop — do‘kon, bank — bank, stadium — stadion, bridge — ko‘prik.
Misol: A doctor works in a hospital. What does your mum do? — She is a teacher.
Kasb oldidan a / an: a pilot, an artist.

title.uz: There is / There are, some / any
title.en: There is / There are, some / any
title.ru: There is / There are, some / any

theory.uz:
There is + birlik: There is a park near my house.  There are + ko‘plik: There are two shops.
Inkor: There isn't a cinema. There aren't any trees. Savol: Is there a bank? Are there any shops?
some — darak gapda, any — inkor va savolda: There is some milk. Is there any juice?
Sanaladigan otlar (apple, egg) bilan — How many? Sanalmaydigan (milk, water, bread) bilan — How much?
Sanalmaydigan otlarga -s qo‘shilmaydi: water (waters emas), bread (breads emas).

can — qila olmoq (qobiliyat) yoki mumkin (ruxsat): I can swim. Can I open the window?
can't — qila olmaslik yoki mumkin emas: You can't play football in the classroom.
must — shart, kerak (qoida): You must wear a seat belt.
mustn't — mumkin emas, taqiqlangan: You mustn't run in the corridor.
can va must dan keyin fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: She must go. (She must goes, must to go — xato.)

Fasllar: spring — bahor, summer — yoz, autumn — kuz, winter — qish.
Oylar (doim bosh harf bilan): January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August,
September, October, November, December.  Oy va fasl oldidan in: in May, in summer.
What's the weather like? — It's sunny / rainy / cloudy / windy / snowy / hot / cold / warm.
Misol: In winter it's cold and snowy. My birthday is in April.

title.uz: Past Simple: was / were, went, saw
title.en: Past Simple: was / were and verbs
title.ru: Past Simple: was / were и глаголы

theory.uz:
to be o‘tgan zamonda: I / he / she / it was; we / you / they were. I was at home yesterday.
To‘g‘ri fe’llar -ed oladi: play → played, watch → watched, like → liked, stop → stopped.
Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni yodlash kerak: go → went, see → saw, have → had, eat → ate, do → did,
come → came, buy → bought.  Inkor va savol: did + fe’lning oddiy shakli — I didn't go. Did you see it?
Kalit so‘zlar: yesterday, last week, last summer, two days ago.

Qarama-qarshi sifatlar: big — small, long — short, hot — cold, fast — slow,
old — young, happy — sad, loud — quiet, open — closed.
Sifat otdan oldin keladi: a fast car, a small house. Yoki to be dan keyin: The soup is hot.
Keyingi mavzuda sifatlarni taqqoslaymiz: big → bigger → the biggest.

Qisqa sifatlar: -er (qiyosiy daraja), the …-est (orttirma daraja): tall → taller → the tallest.
e bilan tugasa: nice → nicer → the nicest. Undosh ikkilanadi: big → bigger → the biggest, hot → hotter.
Undosh + y → -ier / -iest: happy → happier → the happiest, easy → easier.
Uzun sifatlar — more / the most: beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful.
Maxsus: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst.
Taqqoslashda than: An elephant is bigger than a horse.

Matnni o‘qishdan oldin savolga qarang — nimani izlash kerakligini bilib olasiz.
Keyin matnni diqqat bilan o‘qing va javobni matndan toping.
Savol so‘ziga e’tibor bering: Who? — kim, Where? — qayerda, When? — qachon, What? — nima.
True / False: fikr matnga mos kelsa — To‘g‘ri, mos kelmasa — Noto‘g‘ri.
